The case: multiple people involved in fraudulent enrollment of loss-of-land farmers into pension insurance, using public land allocation and collecting cash fees. They provided false identity information, misappropriated public funds, and obtained money by fraudulent means. Likely crimes: "诈骗" (fraud), "职务侵占" maybe, "非法占有公共财产", "贪污" (embezzlement), "受贿"? They are village cadres using their positions to collect fees. They used public land to claim insurance eligibility, then sold insurance slots to relatives for cash. This is fraudulent procurement of social security benefits, i.e., "诈骗" (fraud) and "职务侵占" (misappropriation of public funds) or "贪污罪". In Chinese criminal law, using public land to get insurance benefits and selling them is "非法占有公共财产" maybe "职务侵占罪". Also "诈骗罪" for defrauding the social security system. The pattern: they provided false personal info to get insurance, then collected cash as fees. That's fraud. Also they used their positions (village cadres) to obtain benefits, which is "受贿"? The description: they used public land (19.09 acres) to allocate to individuals, then reported to social insurance bureau to get insurance. They collected cash as fees. This is misappropriation of public property for personal gain. So likely charges: "诈骗罪" and "贪污罪".
